about: The one look of both apps (I Know and I Know Book). Change a value here, then run `node scripts/make-theme.mjs` (the build runs it too): it writes dream-ext/static/theme.css (every web page), dream-ext/src/theme.ts (the tutor inside its shadow roots, and the scripts) and ios/YTLearn/Theme.swift (the native screens). Never edit those three by hand. Text colours keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1 on bg, raised and sunken (WCAG AA); faint is only for things that need not be read (dividers, a disabled look, placeholders). Accent = the warm brown / gold; no iOS blue; green and red only for on and off / stop.

sunken.use: text fields, tracks, segmented control background

lineStrong.use: the border of an outline button, a field in focus

accent.use: the one accent: main buttons, the chosen option, links, the tint of the native views

accentText.use: text and icons on an accent fill

accentSoft.use: the background of a chosen option (accent text on it stays at 4.5:1)

onText.use: text and icons on an on fill

offText.use: text and icons on an off fill

hard.use: the mark under a hard word

learning.use: the mark of a word being learned

ui.css: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

zh.css: "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

caption.use: the smallest text allowed, captions only

icons.about: One icon set: SF Symbols in the native views; on the web the same names drawn as line icons (dream-ext/src/icons.ts), 24 px, stroke 1.7.
